context:
You said, 12:45 CDT: the mockups were black screens, so you couldn't see a difference. Redrawn (PR #860, checked in light and dark).

A picture taller than the card's 480px box now scrolls. #806 keeps today's scale, so a tall phone picture draws about 120px wide (5A). The designer recommends drawing it about 222px wide, the width a phone picture gets in a card (5B). Not blocking: #806 merges either way.

options.gain: Every picture on the page keeps one scale rule.
options.label: 5A: keep today's scale
options.lose: A tall phone screen draws narrow, so its text is hard to read without View.

options.gain: A tall phone screen is readable right in the card.
options.how: A follow-up lane widens the scrolling case only.
options.label: 5B: draw it about 222 wide
options.lose: A second scale rule; one more small lane.

ref: c204 (a tall picture on a waiting-page card scrolls), PR #806, batch 21; mockup docs/design/c204-scroll.html on its branch
title: How wide should a scrolling picture draw on a card?
why: The designer's pick: the scroll exists so you can read a tall screen in place, and at 120 wide you can't.
